complexity.notes: Initializing best_buy to 100 relies on the stated constraint prices[i] <= 100; using float('inf') (or prices[0]) would be more robust and idiomatic. Iterating with 'for price in prices' would be cleaner than indexing via range(len(prices)).
complexity.summary: Single-pass scan tracking the minimum price seen so far (best_buy) and the maximum profit achievable by selling at the current day. Returns the best profit found, defaulting to 0 if no profitable transaction exists.
